#### `stc.relics.hardening.network.enable`

Whether to enable network sysctl hardening (spoofing, redirects, SYN flood).

- **Type:** `boolean`
- **Default:** `false`
- **Example:** `true`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/nixos/hardening/network.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/hardening/network.nix)

#### `stc.relics.hardening.network.strictArp`

ARP hardening (arp_ignore=1, arp_announce=2). Off by default: these
restrict which addresses a host answers/announces ARP for and can break
multi-homed hosts, Linux bridges, and container/Docker networking (which
the docker-server cogitator uses). Enable only on single-homed hosts where you have
verified it does not disturb the network stack.

- **Type:** `boolean`
- **Default:** `false`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/nixos/hardening/network.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/hardening/network.nix)

#### `stc.relics.hardening.network.strictIpv6RouterAdvertisements`

Refuse IPv6 Router Advertisements (accept_ra=0). Off by default: an RA
is how SLAAC hosts learn their prefix and default route, so disabling
acceptance strands any host that is not statically addressed. Enable on
hosts with static IPv6 (or no IPv6 at all), where accepting an RA from
an untrusted L2 segment would let a neighbour inject a prefix and a
default route.

- **Type:** `boolean`
- **Default:** `false`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/nixos/hardening/network.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/hardening/network.nix)

#### `stc.relics.hardening.network.strictReversePathFilter`

Reverse-path filtering mode (rp_filter). true = strict (1), the safe
default for a single-homed host: packets arriving on an interface that
would not be used to reach the source are dropped. Set to false = loose
(2) for asymmetric routing, multi-homed hosts, or WireGuard/policy-routing
setups where strict mode breaks legitimate return paths.

- **Type:** `boolean`
- **Default:** `true`
- **Declared in:** [`relics/nixos/hardening/network.nix`](https://github.com/gfriloux/stc/blob/main/relics/nixos/hardening/network.nix)
